data.name: Jawahir
data.gender_notes: Jawahir is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jawahir is the plural form of Jawhar, which refers to pearls in Arabic. In Islamic tradition, pearls symbolize purity, innocence, and beauty. The name Jawahir carries the meaning “Pearls” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawahir usually hope their child will grow to embody pearls and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Quran 72:10, 'And they will be given to drink of a cup mixed with Zafar (Zafir) and Tasnim (Tasnim is a type of pearl).'
data.etymology: Jawahir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pearls.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawahir total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hindi.name: जवाहिर

in_hindi.long_meaning: जवाहिर नाम का अर्थ और वास्तविक अर्थ: जवाहिर नाम का अर्थ है सुंदरता, चमक, भाग्य, मंगल, और मंगलमयी । यह नाम अपने अर्थ के लिए जाना जाता है, जो कि एक सुंदर और मंगलमयी नाम है । इस नाम का उपयोग भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में किया जाता है, जो कि इसे अपने बच्चों के नाम के रूप में चुनते हैं ।

in_english.name: Jawahir
in_english.meaning: Meaning: Beauty, brilliance, blessings, virtues, and good deeds
in_english.long_meaning: Jawahir name meaning and etymology: Jawahir name comes from the Arabic root of Jawhar, which means beauty, brilliance, blessings, virtues, and good deeds. In Islamic tradition, Jawahir name is associated with the qualities of a good Muslim, including beauty, brilliance, blessings, virtues, and good deeds. The name Jawahir is also associated with the Arabic word Jawhar, which means beauty or brilliance. Jawahir name has been used in various forms throughout history, including in Arabic, Turkish, and Urdu languages. In modern times, Jawahir name is used in many Muslim cultures around the world, including in the Middle East, South Asia, and Southeast Asia.

data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic teachings, the pearl represents the purified soul, striving for spiritual growth and beauty within one's inner self. Islamic scholars illustrate this through various Hadiths and Quranic verses, such as the belief that pearls are gathered in the gardens of paradise, emphasizing their rarity, worth, and desirability as a heavenly reward for righteous deeds. Thus, Jawahir enables its bearer to embody the ethos of constant self-improvement and desirability in both spiritual and worldly contexts.
